mdor/ sbyin pa (155na)po dang*/ len pa po dang*/ sbyin pa rnams ni mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs su med ces so// ched du bya ba'i 'jug sgrub ni/ mdor/ sgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i don du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom par byed do// zhes so// mngon shes drug gi 'jug sgrub ni/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir na sems can yongs su smin par byed do// zhes so// rnam kun mkhyen pa'i 'jug sgrub ni/ mdo las/ de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob nas kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang zhes bya ba nas/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskor bar mi nus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ro// zhes so//

gnyis pa rtogs par dka' ba bsam gtan gzugs med kyi mtha' dpyad pa la/ 'thob byed kyi rgyu/ 'thob bya'i ngo bo/ thob pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po la/ lus rten/ sems rten/ 'thob byed kyi rgyu'i rab dbye dang gsum/ dang po la'ang*/ 'gro ba gang gis thob pa dang*/ khams gang du thob pa dang*/ gang zag gang gi rgyud la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug gang ldan dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ngan song gsum/ sgra mi snyan/ za ma ma ning rnams ma gtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams lus rten du rung ste/ de rnams sdom pa'i lus rten du rung ba gang zhig dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yin na sdom pa yin dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ de'ang ngan song gsum dang sgra mi snyan pa la mi skye ste/ rnam smin gyi (155ba)sgrib pas bsgribs pa'i phyir dang*/ za ma dang ma ning la'ang mi skye ste las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa khams gang du thob pa ni/ spyi ldog nas dngos po'i snyoms 'jug sngar med gsar du thob pa 'dod pa'i rten la thob dgos te/ khams gong du skye ba la de thob la ma nyams pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po nas srid rtse'i bar brgyad las/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi sngar med gsar du skye ba 'dod rten kho na las skye ste/ khams gong du skye ba la de thob la ma nyams pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang so sor zhib tu bshad na/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun dang*/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi ste 'khor ba'i gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis las tshangs ris yan gyi gnas nyer gcig po re re la'ang rang rang gi nyer bsdogs dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis gnyis kyi tha snyad byed la/ de yang mdzod rang 'grel du phyir mi 'ong khri nyis stong dgu brgya drug cu 'chad pa'i skabs su gnas gcig na rigs drug go /rigs re re'ang gnas kyi 'ching ba mtha' dag dang ldan pa nas rang gi gnas kyi rnam pa brgyad la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i bar dgu dgu ste/

de dag ni dgu drug go /dgu drug ni lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'o// lnga bcu rtsa bzhi phrag bcu drug ni brgyad brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// de'ang dbang po'i bye brag gis gsum du 'gyur te zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod nyon dgu dang*/ tshangs ris kyi nyon mongs dgu dang*/ tshangs mdun gyi de dgu dang*/ tshangs chen gyi de dgu rnams rim gyis spangs pa'i gang zag yod par bstan pas nyon mongs de dgu tshan rnams rim gyis spong ba'i nyer bsdogs dang*/ rim gyis spangs pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yod (156na)par bzhed pa'i phyir na tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs yid byed drug dang*/ de'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug chung 'bring chen po gsum yod par bzhed dgos la/ des mtshon nas 'og min gyi bar la'ang rigs 'gre bas tshangs ris kyi rten la tshangs mdun gyi nyer bsdogs sngar med gsar du sgrub pa yod cing*/ tshangs mdun gyi nyer bsdogs de bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs yin pas/ bsam gtan dang po'i rten la'ang bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs sgrub pa yod do// des na bsam gtan dang po'i nang tshan gyi tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi sngar med gsar du sgrub pa 'dod rten la yod cing*/ tshangs mdun gyi de dang de tshangs ris dang 'dod rten la sgrub/ tshangs chen gyi de dang de tshangs mdun gyi de man la sgrub/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i nang tshan 'od chung gi de dang de tshangs chen man gyi rten la sgrub/ gnyis pa'i nang tshan tshad med 'od kyi de dang de 'od chung dang*/ de man gyi rten la sgrub pa sogs gnas ris bcu bdun po thams cad la rigs bsgres pas 'og min gyi nyer bsdogs dang*/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gya nom snang man/ 'dod pa yan gyi gnas bcu bdun po ci rigs pa'i rten la sgrub cing*/ gzugs med bzhi yang de dang rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o// thob zin gnas pa'i lus rten ni 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar gyi gnas nyer gnyis po thams cad kyi rten la mngon du 'gyur ba yod de/

de rnams kyi rten la bsam gtan dang po nas srid rtse'i bar gang rung ci rigs pa'i srid pa'i rten 'brel mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa gang zag gang gi rgyud la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug gang ldan dpyad pa ni/ mthar (156ba)gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dang po brgyad gang rung rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod de/ de'i rgyud la bsam gtan gzugs med brgyad po gang rung gi nyer bsdogs mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir dang*/ de yod na de brgyad po gang rung gi dngos gzhi mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir te/ de gang rung gi 'du byed kyi rten 'brel mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir dang*/ de gang rung gi srid pa'i rten 'brel mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir ro// lam zhugs kyi dbang du byas na theg gsum gyi lam zhugs gsum las/ nyan thos la cig car ba/ chags bral sngon song*/ rim gyis pa ste gsum gyi dang po la/ cig car ba'i nyan thos slob pa'i rgyud la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug rnams kyi nang nas tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs kho na ldan gyi/ tshangs ris yan gyi dngos gzhi ldan pa ni ma yin te/ cig car ba'i slob pa'i 'phags lam mnyam bzhag yin na snyoms 'jug yin dgos shing*/ de yin na tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi ma thob pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de yang tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi thob pa la 'dod nyon dgu pa spang dgos shing*/ de lta bu'i cig car ba'i rigs kyi nyan thos des 'dod nyon dgu pa spang ba'i tshe srid nyon dgu pa yang spang dgos la/ srid nyon dgu pa spangs ba'i nyan thos yin na mi slob pa yin dgos pas shes so// cig car ba'i dgra bcom thob ma thag pa ni shes rab rkyang grol yin pas tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa ma spangs pas de'i dngos gzhi mi thob la/ de ma thob pa'i snyoms 'jug yin na tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/

dngos gzhi mi ldan pa'i tshul slob pa dang 'dra'o// cig car ba'i (157na)dgra bcom pa thob nas bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bsgrubs te/ dgra bcom pa rgyan can du gyur pa'ang yod la/ de yan ni dngos gzhi thob ma thob ci rigs par yod do// chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong gnyis las/ dang po la/ chags bral sngon song gi rigs can gyi nyan thos kyi sbyor lam tha ma man chad du tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dang po bzhi nges par thob dgos te/ de man du 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pa'i nyer bsdogs thob dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang lam ma zhugs dang tshogs sbyor ci rigs su gyur pas thob pa yod do// tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dpyod pa yid byed dang*/ sbyor mtha' yid byed thob ma thob ci rigs pa yod de/ de'i gnas skabs su 'dod nyon bdun pa dang brgyad pa spangs ma spangs ci rigs yod pas so// chags bral sngon song gi rigs can gyis sdug bsngal chos bzod nas phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu la gnas gnas kyi bar du de'i nyer bsdogs dga' ba sdud pa yid byed dang*/ dpyod pa yid byed dang*/ sbyor mtha' yid byed rnams rgyud la ldan mi ldan ci rigs pa yod do// gnyis pa chags bral sngon song gi rigs can gyi phyir mi 'ong la nyan thos kyi sbyor lam tha ma man chad du tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi thob dgos te/ de man du 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs dgos pas so// de yang lam ma zhugs dang tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs ci rigs su thob bo// tshangs mdun nas srid rtse'i bar gyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi rnams thob ma thob ci rigs su yod de/ tshangs mdun gyi nyon mongs spang ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs pa nas ci yang med kyi nyon mongs dgu pa spangs pa'i bar ci rigs pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ (157ba)de'i phyir mi 'ong gi rigs can gyis sdug bsngal chos bzod nas sgom lam rdor ting la gnas gnas kyi bar du tshangs mdun gyi dngos gzhi nas srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i bar nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi thob ma thob ci rigs pa yod de/

de'i bar du/ rang rang gi nyer bsdogs la brten nas rang rang gi dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i sbyor ba byas pa'i tshe thob pa gang zhig /de ma byas par tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi zag med tsam la brten nas nyon mongs lhag ma gzhan spangs te dgra bcom pa thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma grub ste/ tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs zag med la brten nas dgra bcom thob pa yod pas so// gsum pa rim gyis pa'i nyan thos la 'bras bu bzhi'i rigs can bzhi las/ rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs kyis sbyor lam tha ma man du tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid la byed pa thob dgos te/ der snyoms 'jug thob dgos pas so// mos pa yid byed dang*/ rab tu dben pa yid byed dang*/ dga' ba sdud pa yid byed rnams thob ma thob ci rigs pa yod de/ 'dod nyon dang po gsum tsam spangs pa'i skabs su mos pa yid byed dang*/ rab tu dben pa yid byed yod cing*/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa tsam spangs pa de'i tshe na dga' sdud thob pa yod pas so// de'i gnas skabs su dpyod pa yid byed dang*/ sbyor mtha' yid byed ma thob pa zhig dgos te/ der 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ de dgos pa'ang der drug pa spangs na chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong du 'gyur bas so// rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs kyi rigs can gyis sdug bsngal chos bzod nas phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu ma thob kyi bar yang de dang 'dra'o// rim gyis pa'i (158na)phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi skabs su nyer bsdogs tha ma gnyis po thob ma thob ci rigs pa yod de/ 'dod nyon bdun pa dang brgyad pa spangs pa'i tshe thob la/ de ma spangs shing bdun pa spang ba'i sbyor ba la ma zhugs pa'i gnas skabs su ma thob pas so// des na rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas la nyer bsdogs dang po bzhi thob cing*/ dngos gzhi sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu yid byed ni ma thob pa zhig nges par dgos te de phyir 'ong yin pas so// rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dang ldan pa ni chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong la ji ltar bshad pa bzhin no//

gnyis pa rang rgyal la/ skye ba'i sgo nas dang*/ lam gyi sgo nas te gnyis las/ dang po la rang rgyal gyis skye ba gcig thogs man du tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs thob pa yod kyang*/ de'i dngos gzhi thob pa ni yod pa ma yin te/ gnas skabs rang rgyal du rigs nges pa'i skye ba gcig thogs gyi rang rgyal yin na/ skye ba phyi mar las nyon gyi dbang gis mi lus nges par len pas khyab pa'i phyir dang*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom yin na mi'i rten can yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ khams dang sa gzhan du rang rgyal dgra bcom brten pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de ltar gyi tshe de rang byung gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'ang yin no// rang rgyal srid pa tha ma pa yan du dngos gzhi thob ma thob ci rigs pa yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam bzhi'i rtogs pa sngon du song ma song ci rigs pa can gyi srid pa tha ma pa'i rang rgyal kyang yod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa lam gyi sgo nas brtsi ba la/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyis sbyor lam nas bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi nges par thob pa yin te/ bse ru lta (158ba)bu de/ drod nas zad mi skye shes pa'i bar thams cad bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten nas stan thog gcig tu bgrod par bshad pas so// tshogs spyod kyi rang rgyal gyis tshogs lam nas bzung ste rang gi mi slob lam gyi bar la dngos gzhi thob ma thob ci rigs pa yod de/ shes rab rkyang grol gyi rang rgyal dgra bcom kyang yod pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa theg chen la nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gang yang ma thob pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa yod de/ snyoms 'jug gi sems la ma brten par sems bskyed kyi cho ga tsam la brten nas byang sdom thob pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa yod pa'i phyir ro// theg chen gyi tshogs lam 'bring gi skabs su'ang thob ma thob ci rigs yod la/ theg chen tshogs chen gyi skabs su/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi nges par thob dgos te/

der rdzu 'phrul sogs thob pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rdzu 'phrul sogs rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la ma brten par yod pa ma yin pa des na'o// rtsa rtags grub ste/ der chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob dgos pa'i phyir ro// theg chen gyi sbyor lam tha ma'i skabs su/ srid rtse'i dngos gzhis thob dgos te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal rjes shes kyi skabs su mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu thob dgos pa gang zhig /theg chen gyi sdug bsngal chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod gsum gyi skabs su mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug gsar du sgrub pa'i sbyor ba byed mi srid pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ ji skad du/ bsam gtan la sogs pa'i yan lag yongs su zad pa dang*/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'dis theg chen gyi sdug bsngal rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu thob kyang (159na)de'i ro myong ba'i rnam smin khams gong du mi skye bas rtogs pa khyad par can thob par bshad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa grub ste/ theg chen sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis mthar gnas kyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rnams dang*/ nyon sgrib zad par spangs pa gang zhig /de gsum gyi skabs su bsam gtan gnyis pa yan gyi nyer bsdogs mi srid cing*/ theg chen gyi sdug bsngal chos bzod yin na bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pas khyab pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ theg chen gyi sdug bsngal chos bzod de la gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i spangs rtogs kyi rigs tshang bar rdzogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yan gyi nyer bsdogs de yin no// skabs de'i bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol lam gang rung min dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ theg chen gyi sdug bsngal la chos bzod pa'i bzod pa yin na/

'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar nus pa sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ldan na de'i rten bsam gtan gyi sems thob pas khyab pa'i phyir ro// bye brag byang 'phags la ldan tshul ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang*/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes rgyud ldan yin na/ de'i rgyud la bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dang ldan dgos te/ theg chen chos mchog tha ma'i skabs su bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sems thob pa'i phyir dang*/ dang por sangs rgyas kyi chos sku thob pa de'ang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas thob dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi de lam sla ba rnams kyi (159ba)nang nas mchog yin pa'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu po gang yang rung ba las gcig ldan pa dang*/ cig shos mi ldan pa'i dbye ba med par snyoms 'jug de dag thams cad la sgrib byed dang bral nas mnyam par bzhag pa 'ba' zhig la gnas pa yin no//

gsum pa 'thob byed rgyu'i rab dbye la/ rgyu'i stobs kyis thob pa dang*/ rigs kyis dang*/ thos pas dang*/ man ngag gis dang*/ chos nyid kyi stobs kyis thob pa dang lnga'o// dang po ni/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi dge rtsa rgya chen bsags pa la brten nas thob pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi rigs sad pa la brten nas thob pa'o// gsum pa ni/ snyoms 'jug ston par byed pa'i gsung rab la thos bsam byas stobs kyis thob pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon gyi man ngag goms pa la brten nas thob pa'o// lnga pa ni/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i lha mi'i rten la snyoms 'jug rang dbang med par skyes nas khams gong du 'pho ba'o// gnyis pa 'thob bya'i ngo bo la/ nyer bsdogs dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi 'thob bya dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug sgrub pa'i sbyor bas bsdus pa'i rigs gnas gang zhig dngos gzhi las gzhan pa'i snyoms 'jug go /de la dbye na/ bsam gzugs kyi nyer bsdogs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyer bsdogs gzhir bzhag la rang gi 'thob bya bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i sbyor bas bsdus pa'i gzugs kyi snyoms 'jug go /de la dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs nas bzhi pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi bar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi nyer (160na)bsdaugs gzhir byas la rang gi 'thob bya bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i sbyor bas bsdus pa'i bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug go /de la dbye na/ yid byed dang*/ gnas dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid rab rig yid byed dang*/ mos byung yid byed dang*/ dben pa yid byed dang*/ dga' sdud yid byed dang*/ dpyod pa yid byed dang*/ sbyor mtha' yid byed dang drug las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs drug gi nang tshan las/

'dod pa la rags pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang po la zhi bar shes pa'i shes pa thos bsam gyi stobs la brten nas der nges pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid rab rig yid la byed pa zhes bya'o// de la gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na/ tshangs ris/ tshangs 'dun mdun tshangs chen gsum gyi nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid rab rig yid byed kyang gsum du yod do// ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs rab rig yid byed la/ zag med dang dag pa ba gnyis so// lam gyi sgo nas dbye na/ theg dman gyi tshogs lam dang*/ sbyor lam dang*/ mthong lam du gyur pa'i nyer bsdogs rab tu rig pa'i yid byed de dang*/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam du gyur pa'i nyer bsdogs de lta bu dang bzhi'o// byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'du byed kyi rten 'brel du gyur pa de'i nyer bsdogs dang*/ thar lam du gyur pa'i de'i nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid rab rig gnyis gnyis yod do// gnyis pa bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mos pa yid byed ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug (160ba)gi nang tshan las/ rang 'thob byed bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mtshan nyid rab rig rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ rang gi 'thob bya bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs dben pa yid byed thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i rigs gnas de/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs mos pa yid byed rgyud ldan gyi rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug go /de la dbye na/ gnas dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ byed las dang*/ lam gyi sgo nas dbye ba bzhi snga ma dang 'dra'o// gsum pa bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs rab dben yid byed ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs drug po gang rung las/ rang gi 'thob bya dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi sgrib pa chen po spong bzhin pa'i rigs gnas gang zhig /dang po'i nyer bsdogs rab dben yid byed rgyud ldan gyi rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug go

/dbye sgo snga ma dang 'dra'o// bzhi pa dang po'i nyer bsdogs dga' sdud ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs drug po gang rung las 'dod nyon chen po spangs pa'i dga' bde cung zad dang ldan cing*/ rang gi 'thob bya dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi sgrib pa 'bring spong bzhin pa'i rigs gnas gang zhig /dang po'i nyer bsdogs dga' sdud yid byed rgyud ldan gyi rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba sngar bzhin/ lnga pa dang po'i nyer bsdogs dpyod pa yid byed ni/ dang po'i yid byed drug gang rung las/ skyon lhag ma ma lus pa la dpyod byed kyi rigs gnas gang zhig /shes bzhin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i dang po'i nyer bsdogs dpyod pa yid byed rgyud ldan gyi rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba sngar bzhin/ drug pa dang po'i nyer bsdogs sbyor mtha' yid byed ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug (161na)gang rung las rang gi 'thob bya dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi sgrib pa chung ngu spong bzhin pa'i rigs gnas gang zhig /dang po'i nyer bsdogs sbyor mtha' yid byed rgyud ldan gyi rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba sngar bzhin/ gnyis pa bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ chung 'bring chen po gsum du yod de/ rang gi 'thob bya bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi sgrib pa chen po skor gsum/ 'bring skor gsum/ chung ngu skor gsum yod pa spangs pa'i nyer bsdogs chung 'bring che gsum yod pa la de dang der 'jog pa yin no// gsum pa bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ dngos gzhi dngos kyi sbyor bar gyur pa'i de dang*/ brgyud pa'i sbyor bar gyur pa'i de gnyis la nyer bsdogs yid byed snga ma lnga ni brgyud pa'i sbyor ba yin la/ drug pa ni dngos kyi sbyor ba'o//

bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyi dogs dpyod la/ dngos gzhi sgrub tshul la dpyad/ mi lcogs med la dpyad/ nyon mongs can yod med la dpyad/ grogs brtson 'grus la dpyad/ tshor ba gang ldan la dpyad pa dang lnga las/ dang po la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin na/ de'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug sngon song gis khyab ste/ de yin na bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi nyon sgrib dgu pa spong byed kyi nyer bsdogs yid byed drug pa sngon song yin dgos shing*/ de yin na de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu pa spang bar byas zin pa'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug pa de sngon song yin dgos (161ba)pa'i phyir ro// dang po grub ste/ de yin na de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi nyon mongs dgu pa spang bar byas pa'i nyer bsdogs sngon song yin dgos pa gang zhig /dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi nyon sgrib chen po skor gsum rang gi ngo skal gyi spang byar byas nas spong ba'i nyer bsdogs la rab dben dang*/ 'bring skor gsum der byas nas spong ba'i nyer bsdogs la de'i nyer bsdogs dga' sdud dang*/ chung ngu skor gsum der byas nas spong ba'i nyer bsdogs la de'i nyer bsdogs sbyor mtha' yid byed kyis khyab pa'i phyir ro// rtsa rtags ma grub na/ der thal/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin na/ de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi nyon sgrib spangs pas khyab cing*/ de 'dra'i sgrib pa de spong ba'i sbyor ba ma byas par ni de'i dngos gzhi thob pa med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa grub ste/ de yin na de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu pa spong bar byed pa'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug sngon song yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de yin na de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu po spangs pas khyab pa'i phyir ro//

gnyis pa la/ lam ma zhugs kyi skabs dang*/ lam zhugs kyi skabs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lam ma zhugs kyi mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug brgyad sgrub pa'i tshe/ de dang de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi 'og sa'i nyon mongs dgu dang*/ snyoms 'jug der gyur gyi sgrib pa dgu spangs nas bsgrub dgos te/ lam ma zhugs kyi bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin na/ de'i nyer bsdogs la brten nas de'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi nyon sgrib dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu pa gnyis spang bar byas pa las thob dgos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa lam zhugs la/ nyan (162na)thos dang*/ theg chen gyi lam gnyis las/ dang po la/ cig car ba dang*/ rim gyis pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ cig car ba'i nyan thos slob pa'i rang lam na rang gi spang bya 'dod nyon dgu spong ba'i tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs yid byed drug yod kyi/ de'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu spong byed kyi nyer bsdogs yid byed drug dang*/ de la brten nas dngos gzhi sgrub pa med de/ cig car ba'i nyan thos slob pa yin na tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi ma thob pas khyab pa'i phyir/ cig car ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom thob ma thag pa'i skabs su shes rab rkyang grol yin pas cig car ba'i nyan thos slob pa dang 'dra la/ dgra bcom thob rjes su bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi gdod bsgrubs nas thob pa yod do// gnyis pa rim gyis pa la/ bsam gtan dang po dang*/ gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po lam ma zhugs la ji lta ba de lta'o// gnyis pa la/ dang por bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi zag med la brten nas rang sa'i nyon mongs dgu spangs rjes su/ gnyis pa'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug la brten nas/ gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu pa spangs pa la brten nas/ gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhig dang*/

dang por bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs dgu dang*/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu po sbrags te spang bar byas pa la brten nas/ gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi thob rjes dngos gzhi zag med bzhi po gang rung la brten nas de gnyis kyi sa bon spong bar byed pa'i rim gyis pa'i phyir (162ba)mi 'ong zhig dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs dgu tshan nas srid nyon dgu pa'i bar rim can du spangs te/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi mngon du ma byas par yang dgra bcom mngon du byed pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhig dang gsum yod do// gnyis pa theg chen lam du ni dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i dang*/ de sngon du song ba'i lam du bsam gzugs sgrub tshul la gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam ma zhugs dang mthun/ gnyis pa la/ cig car ba dang*/ rim gyis pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi khyad par las theg chen gyi lam du sgrub tshul gnyis kyi dang po ni/ cig car ba'i dgra bcom shes rab rkyang grol gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi theg chen lam pa de/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spong bar byed pa'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug sgrub pa yin gyi/ 'dod nyon dgu spong byed kyi dang po'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug sgrub pa med de/ de'i snga nas 'dod nyon dgu spangs zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyi ga'i cha las rnam grol gyi dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi theg chen lam pa/ bsam gtan dang po sogs kyi dngos gzhi sgrub pa med de/ de'i snga rol du thob zin pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong gi rtogs pa sngon song gi theg chen lam pas ni/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi sgrub pa yod kyi/ tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi sgrub pa ni med de/ de'i snga rol du thob zin pas so// phyir 'ong dang rgyun zhugs tsam gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi theg chen lam pas ni/

sngar ma spangs pa'i rang sa las 'bral byed dang*/ gong sa 'thob byed la sgrib pa'i sgrib pa lhag ma rnams spong bar byed pa'i nyer bsdogs sgrub pa yod do// gnyis pa mi (163na)lcogs med la dpyad pa la/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyi nang tshan tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dang*/ nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med gnyis don gcig ste/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ nyer bsdogs rnams kyi dang po ni mi lcogs pa med pa ste/ de ni dag pa'ang yin la zag med kyang yin no zhes gsungs pas/ lam ma zhugs la ni nyer bsdogs de dag pa bar 'jog la/ cig car dgra bcom pa'i rigs can la ni/ nyer bsdogs de khams gsum sa dgu'i nyon mongs rnams cig car du spong ba'i sems rten byed pas nyer bsdogs zag med du'ang 'jog go / gsum pa nyer bsdogs nyon mongs can yod med dpyad pa ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs la/ nyon mongs can med de/ dang po'i gnas gsum po gang gi yang nyon mongs pa der med pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan de dang de'i dngos gzhi ma thob par de dang de'i nyon mongs mngon du 'gyur ba med pas so// bzhi pa grogs brtson 'grus la dpyad pa la/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyi grogs ni/ gus sbyor rkyang ldan/ rtag sbyor rkyang ldan/ mi zlog rkyang ldan/ gus rtag gnyis ldan/ gus sbyor mi zlog pa gnyis ldan/ rtag sbyor mi zlog pa gnyis ldan/ gsum ga dang ldan pa ste ldan tshul bdun gyi sgo nas yod do// lnga pa tshor ba la dpyad pa ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs de la/ tshor ba bde ba/ yid bde/ btang snyoms dang gsum yod do// de ltar na/ mdzod las/00000000 dag pa bde min sdug bsngal min// ces btang snyoms kho nar bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni bye smra'i lugs yin gyi/ de'i nyer bsdogs sim par nyams su myong ba yod pas tshor ba bde ba dang yid bde yod do// (163ba) gnyis pa bsam gtan gnyis pa'i nyer bsdogs ni/

bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs gzhir byas la/ rang gi 'thob bya bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi la nye bar sbyor ba'i bsam gtan gnyis pa'i khongs su sdud pa'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba la/ gnas kyi sgo nas 'od chung*/ tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal gyi nyer bsdogs dang gsum las/ de re re la'ang rang sa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spong byed dang*/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs dgu spong byed kyi nyer bsdogs yid byed drug tshan gnyis re yod do// gnyis pa na nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med yod pa ma yin te/ gnyis pa yan gyi nyer bsdogs yin na thar lam ma yin dgos pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan des na tshangs mdun dang*/ tshangs chen gyi nyer bsdogs la'ang mi lcogs med pa yod pa ma yin no// bsam gtan gsum pa'i nyer bsdogs ni/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs gzhir byas la/ rang gi 'thob bya gsum pa'i dngos gzhi la nyer sbyor gyi sbyor ba gang zhig /bsam gtan gsum pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye na/ dge chung*/ tshad med dge /dge rgyas kyi nyer bsdogs te re re zhing 'og sa'i nyon mongs dang*/ gong sa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu tshan gnyis spangs pa'i nyer bsdogs yid byed drug tshan gnyis re yod do//

bsam gtan bzhi pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi ngo bo ni/ snga ma rnams la dpags te shes par nus la/ gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na/ sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che/ mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ shin tu mthong*/ gya nom snang*/ 'og min te de rnams kyi nyer bsdogs brgyad la so sor yid byed drug tshan gnyis sogs sngar ltar ro// gnyis pa gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs/ nam (164na)mkha'/ rnam shes/ ci yang med rnams kyang snga mas shes nus so// srid rtse'i nyer bsdogs ni gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs gzhir byas la rang gi 'thob bya srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i nyer sbyor gyi sbyor bas bsdus shing*/ dngos gzhi las gzhan pa'i srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye na/ 'og sa dang gong sa'i nyon mongs dang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dgu tshan spong ba la bltos pa'i de'i nyer bsdogs rab dben/ dga' sdud/ sbyor mtha' rnams yod cing*/ nyer bsdogs snga ma rnams yod med dpyad dgos so// tshor ba'i khyad par ni bzhi pa'i nyer bsdogs nas srid rtse'i nyer bsdogs kyi bar thams cad btang snyoms kho na'o// gnyis pa mthar gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo ni/ rang 'thob byed rang rang gi nyer bsdogs la brten nas sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu yid byed du gyur pa'i snyoms 'jug go / de la dbye na/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gzhir byas la gtso bor yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa la chags bral gyi rigs gnas sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu gang zhig /nyer bsdogs las gzhan gzugs kyi snyoms 'jug go / de la dbye na/ dang po'i dngos gzhi nas bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i bar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ mdor/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dod pas dben/ sdig to mi dge ba'i chos kyis dben/ rtog pa dang bcas/ dpyod pa dang bcas/ dben pa las skyes pa'i bde ba dang dga' ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so// zhes pas/

dang po'i dngos gzhi gzhir byas la rtog dpyod gnyen (164ba)po'i yan lag gis rang 'thob bya'i gegs gyur gyi nyon mongs dang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa la chags bral byas shing*/ dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'i rigs gnas rtse gcig pa de dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug go / de la yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na/ dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam khyad gnyis/ dang po ni/ dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam khyad gang rung yang yin/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka gnyen po'i yan lag tu ldan pa'i rigs gnas kyang yin pa de tsam po ba'i dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ de gang rung yang yin/ rtog pa dang mi ldan cing dpyod pa gnyen po'i yan lag tu ldan pa'i rigs gnas kyang yin pa khyad par can gyi dngos gzhi'o// yang de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ dang po'i dngos gzhi dag pa ba/ zag med/ nyon mongs can dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can 'jig rten pa'i dge bar gyur pa'i gzugs kyi sas bsdus kyi dang po'i dngos gzhi de'o// de'i ming gi khyad par ni/ dngos gzhi zag bcas dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi dang*/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi dang po'i dngos gzhi rnams so// de la'ang ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyams pa cha mthun/ gnas pa cha mthun/ khyad par cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dang po'i dngos gzhi dag pa ba de rang sa'i nyon mongs kyis gzir nas nyams pa dang rjes su mthun pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de'i rjes su rigs 'drar gyur pa'i dngos gzhi dag pa ba skye ba'i rjes su mthun pa'o// gsum pa ni/ rang gi rjes su dag pa ba'i gnyis pa yan gyi dngos gzhi skye ba'i rjes su mthun pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi rjes su (165na)dang po'i dngos gzhi zag med skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'o// gnyis pa bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi zag med ni/ bden pa'i rnam pa can gyis 'das lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i snyoms 'jug go

/de la yan lag gis dbye na/ tsam khyad gnyis/ theg pas dbye na/ 'phags pa gsum gyi de gsum mo// gsum pa dang po'i dngos gzhi nyon mongs can ni/ dang po'i dngos gzhi dag pa ba/ zag med/ nyon mongs can gsum ga'i ting nge 'dzin nyon mongs pa can dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o// de la dbye na/ rtsa nyon shas che ba'i dang*/ nye nyon shas che ba'i de gnyis so// de ltar gong du bshad pa'i dang po'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yan lag lnga ldan du bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ dang po'i yan lag lnga'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi rtog pa'am/ sems rtsing bas 'jug pa'i rtog pa'am/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i rtog pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dang po'i yan lag lnga'i nang tshan gang zhig de'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i zhib mo'i rnam pas 'jug pa'i dpyod pa'o// gsum pa ni/ snga ma ltar gang zhig sim par nyams su myong ba'i yid bde'o// bzhi pa ni/ snga ma ltar gang zhig tshor ba bde ba'i khyad par gyi chos lus la phan 'dogs pas na bde ba dang*/ sems la phan 'dogs kyi chos dga' bar 'dod do// lnga pa ni/ gang zhig dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'o// lnga po de yan lag yin pa ni de'i ngo bo yin pa'i cha nas yan lag tu bzhag pa yin te/ dper na dang po'i dngos gzhi dag pa ba'i ngor gyur gyi yid shes kyi 'khor du byung ba'i rtog dpyod sogs lnga po de de'i ngo bo dang yan lag (165ba)gi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ de grub ste/ de'i ngo bo gang zhig /yan lag kyang yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ rtog dpyod gnyen po dang*/ dga' bde phan yon dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag yin pa dang*/ de lngas dang po'i dngos gzhi ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob zin rgyun ldan du gnas par byed pa'i phyir ro// 'o na dang po'i dngos gzhi zag bcas dang zag med gnyis ka yan lag lnga ldan yin nam zhe na/ dang po'i zag bcas tsam po ba la lnga ka ldan cing*/

khyad par can la rtog pa ma gtogs gzhan bzhi po ldan la/ zag med la rtog dpyod ma gtogs gzhan gsum po ldan no// gnyis pa bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ mdor/ rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dwangs te sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rtog pa med cing dpyod pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so// zhes gsungs pas/ de ni gzugs kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gzhir byas la nang rab dwangs sogs yan lag bzhi ldan cing dang po'i nyon mongs dgu pa la chags bral gyi ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug go /de la gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'od chung ba sogs gsum mo// ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ dag pa ba/ zag med/ nyon mongs can dang gsum ste/ dang po'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin shes par bya'o// bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i yan lag bzhi ni/ nang rab dwangs gnyen po'i yan lag dang*/ dga' ba dang bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag dang*/ ting nge 'dzin (166na)gnas kyi yan lag dang bzhi las/ dang po'i ngo bo ni/ dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi skyon rtog dpyod las 'das pa'i sgo nas sems rgyud nang rab tu zhi zhing dwangs pa'i cha nas bsam gtan gnyis pa'i yan lag tu bzhag pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshor ba yid bde'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dga' ba'o// gsum pa ni/ tshor ba sems bde'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bde ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ dge sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// gsum pa bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ mdo las/ de dga' ba la 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan cing shes bzhin du btang snyoms la gnas te bde ba lus kyis myong la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pas bde ba la rnam par dpyod pa btang snyoms so// zhes brjod pa ste/

dga' ba med pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so zhes gsungs pas/ de ni bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi gzhir byas la gnyen po'i yan lag dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum gyis gnyis pa'i sas bsdus kyi nyon mongs la chags bral gyi ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa'i tshor bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'i snyoms 'jug go /de la gnas kyis dbye na/ dge chung sogs gsum mo// ngo bos dbye na/ dag pa ba sogs gsum mo// gsum pa'i dngos gzhi'i yan lag lnga ni/ dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum gnyen po'i yan lag /bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag go /de dag gi ngo bo rim bzhin 'di lta ste/ bsam gtan gyi dmigs rnam mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang*/ bsam gtan la skyon (166ba)byung ma byung dpyod pa'i shes bzhin dang*/ bde sdug nye ring chags sdang sogs 'du byed dang bral ba'i 'du byed btang snyoms kyi ngo bo dang*/ tshor ba sems bde'i ngo bor gyur pa dang*/ dge sems rtse gcig pa'i ngo bor gyur pa rnams so// bzhi pa bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ mdo las/ de bde ba yang spangs sdug bsngal yang spangs shing*/ yid bde ba dang mi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas bde ba yang med/ sdug bsngal yang med/ btang snyoms dang dran pa yongs su dag pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i ngo bo ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gzhir byas la/ gnyen po'i yan lag dran pa dang btang snyoms yongs dag gis gsum pa'i nyon mongs dgu pa la chags bral gyi bsam gtan bzhi pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'i bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug go /de la gnas kyis dbye na/ sprin med nas 'og min gyi bar brgyad yod do// ngo bos dbye na/ dag pa ba sogs gsum mo// bzhi pa'i yan lag la bzhi ste/

dran pa/ btang snyoms gnyen po'i yan lag /tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag ste/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi skyon brgyad las grol ba'i dran pa/ gnyis pa ni/ de las grol ba'i 'du byed btang snyoms/ gsum pa ni/ sim gdung bar ma myong ba'i tshor ba/ bzhi pa ni/ dge sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// bsam gtan gyi skyon brgyad ni/ bde sdug /yid bde mi bde/ dbugs dbyung rngub/ rtog dpyod rnams so// gnyis pa gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi ni/ de'i dngos gzhi gzhir byas la gtso (167na)bor 'du shes kyi sgo nas 'og sa las 'das pa'i rigs gnas gong sa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug go /de la dbye na/ nam mkha'i/ rnam shes kyi/ ci yang med kyi/ 'du shes med/ 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dang bzhi las/ dang po'i ngo bo ni/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gzhir byas la/ sbyor ba'i dus su chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam du bsgoms pas dngos gzhi'i dus de mngon du gyur pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug go /de la dbye na/ dngos gzhi dag pa ba la sogs gsum snga ma ltar ro// snyoms 'jug de'i mi mthun phyogs ni/ de thob pa'i gegs gyur gyi nyon sgrib dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spang 'jug shes su gyur pa'i nyon mongs dgu tshan rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ bzhi pa'i sas bsdus kyi snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gzhir byas la/ kha dog dang*/ gzugs kyi 'du shes thogs bcas dang*/ dbyibs kyi 'du shes bzang ngan sna tshogs pa'i 'du shes te/ bzhi pa'i 'du shes rags pa rnams las nges par 'byung ba'i yid la byed pa med pa ni nam mkha'i dngos gzhi yin no// gnyis pa rnam shes mtha' yas kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo ni/

sbyor ba'i dus chos thams cad rnam shes ltar mtha' yas so snyam du bsgoms pas dngos gzhi'i dus su de mngon du gyur pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba sngar ltar ro// gsum pa ci yang med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo ni/ sbyor ba'i dus gzung bya rags pa rnams ci yang med do snyam du bsgoms pas dngos gzhi'i dus de mngon du (167ba)gyur pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba sngar bzhin no// bzhi pa srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo ni/ sbyor ba'i dus gzung bya rags pa yod pa'ang ma yin/ phra ba med pa'ang ma yin snyam du bsgoms pas dngos gzhi'i dus de mngon du gyur pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye ba la/ dbu ma pas snga ma ltar gsum du bzhed kyang*/ bye smras srid rtser zag med mi 'dod do// mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu'i go rim ni rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin no// gsum pa thob 'bras la gnyis/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan dang*/ 'bras bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan dang gzugs kyi rten can gyi gang zag don gcig /rgyu bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug dang gzugs kyi snyoms 'jug don gcig /gzugs med kyang des mtshon no// gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu la/ bdag po'i 'bras bu/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzugs kyi snod zhing dag pa dang*/ spyan lnga mngon shes drug sogs yon tan khyad par can thob pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs kyi skye ba phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs kyi byang phyogs kyi chos sogs thob pa'o// gzugs med la'ang de nyid kyis mtshon te shes par bya'o// gsum pa tshad med pa bzhi'i spyi don la dgu yod pa las/ dang po dmigs pa'i yul ni/ rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi de dag bde 'dod dang*// sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag dang bde ba dang*// rnam pa ni/

sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral (168na)ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can// phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// zhes gsungs pas/ bde ba dang mi ldan pa thams cad bde ba dang phrad 'dod dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod/ bde ba dang ldan pa thams cad de dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dang*/ tshor ba gsum gyi nyon mongs pa sems can thams cad la bral 'dod kyi khyad par la tshad med pa bzhir bzhag go / gnyis pa ngo bo ni/ go rim bzhin du gnod sems dang*/ rnam 'tshe dang*/ mi dga' ba dang*/ chags sdang med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yin no// gsum pa rgyu ni/ mdzod las/00000000 bzhi yis sems dang sems byung rnams// gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa gnyis// gzhan ni gnyis po dag las skye// zhes gsungs pas tshad med bzhi de rkyen bzhi las skye ste/ rgyu'i rkyen rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ bdag po'i rkyen tshad med bzhi ston byed gyi lung dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen no// dmigs rkyen ni/ tshad med bzhi po'i go rim bzhin 'di lta ste/ bde ba mi ldan pa'i sems can dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i dang*/ bde ba dang ldan pa'i dang*/ chags sdang can gyi sems can no// de ma thag rkyen ni/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i phan yon dang*/ ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs la brtags nas goms pa snga ma la brten te skye ba'o// gzhan rnams ni go sla'o//

bzhi pa 'bras bu la gnyis/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o// dang po la gnyis/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don byed pa'i rten du gyur pa'o// dang po ni/ ji skad du/ tshangs pa'i gnas pas (168ba)gnas pa yi// blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye// der ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sems can dag kyang rnam smin byed// kun tu tshangs dang mi 'bral la// de yi mi mthun phyogs dang bral// bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen// mi bzad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/ snying rje dang ni bzod dang sems pa dang*// smon lam skye ba sems can yongs smin byed// dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan// 'di ni snying rje'i ljon shing chen po yin// ces so// gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ ji skad du/ 'tshe spangs byang chub mchog gi sa bon dang*// bde ba bskyed dang gdung byed 'dod pa'i rgyu// ngo bo nyid sbyin chos la brten pa yi// rgyal sras rnams la byang chub thag mi ring*// zhes so// lnga pa byed las la bzhi ste/ ma chags pa'i dang*/ rang bde mi 'dod pa'i dang*/ gzhan bde zil gyis gnon pa'i dang*/ 'khor ba la mi skyo ba'i byed las so// dang po ni/ snying rjes zin pa'i brtse ldan rnams// zhi la'ang yid ni mi gnas na// 'jig rten bde dang rang srog la// chags par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ snying rjes sdug bsngal dag gis sdug bsngal ba// bde ma bskyed par gang gis bde bar 'gyur// de phyir brtse dang ldan pas gzhan bde ba// bskyed nas bdag nyid bde bar byed pa yin// ces so// gsum pa ni/ brtse bas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal 'jig rten gyi// bde ba thams cad zil gyis gnon 'gyur zhing*// don byas rnams kyang de dang mi ldan gang*// de las ngo mtshar che ba ci zhig yod// ces so//

bzhi pa ni/ snying rje blo mchog 'khor bar gtogs pa yi// (169na)sdug bsngal bdag nyid kun dang bdag med pa'ang*// rnam par shes nas skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*// nyes par rab gnod par yang mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// drug pa ldan pa'i yon tan la gsum las/ yon tan dang po bzhi po de la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'bras bur ldan pa yin te/ rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// ces so// yon tan gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni/ ji skad du/ chags pa gang tshe kha na ma tho ba// med dang 'jig rten 'das pa yod ma yin// blo ldan rnams kyi brtse bas byams pa ni// kha na ma tho med cing 'jig rten 'das// zhes so// bdun pa rab dbye la gsum ste/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye na gsum dang*/ drug dang*/ bcur dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /ces so// gnyis pa ni/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse// kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse// yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying brtse dang*// log par mngon par zhen la snying rje'o// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song*// sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs// bgrod dka'i lam la kun tu zhugs// 'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan// zas chen dug dang 'dres la zhen// lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa// lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i// sems can rnams la snying rje'o// zhes pas yul de lta bu la brten nas skyes pa'i tshad med pa bzhi yang de ltar du dbye'o// brgyad pa ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gnod sems dang*// rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang*// 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa// nyes dmigs rnam pa mang la reg /ces so// dgu pa bsgom pa'i phan yon (169ba)ni/ nyes pa 'di kun byams sogs la// legs par gnas la mi 'byung ste// nyon mongs can gyi sems can gyi// don du 'khor ba'ang yongs mi gtong*// zhes gsungs so// de ltar drangs pa'i rgyan gyi lung dngos bstan rnams go sla bas 'dir 'bru ma bkrol kyang 'gal ba med do//

gnyis pa gzhung don la/ sbyar/ rtsa/ 'grel gsum las/ dang po ni/ de ltar sems can gyi don du bsam pas go bgos pa la brten nas sbyor ba de'i bya ba la 'jug pa 'byung bar 'gyur bas de'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa 'di bstan par mdzad pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang*// lam dang byams la sogs pa dang*// dmigs pa med dang ldan pa dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang*// ched du bya dang mngon shes drug /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni// 'jug pa'i sgrub pa theg chen la// 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya// bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi 'jug sgrub dang*/ sbyin sogs phyin drug gi 'jug sgrub dang*/ mthong sgom mi slob khyad par gyi lam rnams kyi 'jug sgrub dang*/ byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi'i 'jug sgrub dang*/ dngos po'am dngos med du dmigs pa med par ldan pa'i 'jug sgrub dang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i 'jug sgrub dang*/ chen po gsum la ched du bya ba'i 'jug sgrub dang*/ mngon shes drug gi 'jug sgrub dang*/ rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ste dgu po 'di dag ni theg pa chen po'i lam la 'dzegs pa'i sgrub pa yin par shes par bya zhes bya ba gsungs pa ni 'dir bkod par mdzad pa ste'o// 'jug sgrub dgu las dang po brgyad ni/ rgyu'i theg chen dang tha ma gcig 'bras bu'i theg chen du bshad la/ dang po gsum rang don dang*/ bar pa gsum gzhan don dang*/ tha ma gsum gnyis don du'ang bshad do// dgu po 'di'i go rim yang 'di kho na ltar 'thad tshul slob dpon gyi bzhed pa ni/ dang por sems brtan par byed/ de nas tshogs gsog par byed/ de nas (170na)lam la 'jug par byed/ de yang gzhan gyi phyir byams sogs bsgom/ de'i 'og tu gzhan gyi 'ching ba dmigs pa gcod par byed/ de la brten nas 'khor gsum yongs su dag par 'gyur zhing*/

gzhan gyi spyod pa rnam par dag pa de'ang rang gi don chen po gsum la 'jug par byed/ de la'ang gzhan gyi sems shes pa sogs la brtson par byed dgos shing*/ de byas nas 'tshang rgya ba la spro ba'i phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa la 'jug cing*/ rtogs pa'i rim pa 'dis theg pa chen po mtha' dag rnam par gnon pa'i phyir dgu po nyid du grangs nges par bshad do// gsum pa 'grel pa ni/ tshor bas nges par 'byung ba bsam gtan dang*/ 'du shes kyis nges par 'byung ba gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang gnyis po 'di ni theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i lam nas ldan pa yin la/ de dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ sa dang por mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom pa'i lam dang*/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma zhi bas mi slob pa'i sa brgyad pa dang*/ khyad par gyi lam sa dgu pa dang bcu par bzhag pa'o// slob dpon bzang po'i zhabs kyis mi slob lam zhes sbyor ba ni mi 'thad ces/ slob dpon a bh+yas/ mi slob pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te bgrod par bya bas lam mo// seng ge bzang pos mi slob pa'i lam gyi ngo bo zhes rnam par gzhag pa ni ngan pa la gnas pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs su mi slob pa nyid mi srid pa'i phyir zhes gsungs nas dran pa nyer gzhag nas ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi bar dag sgom pa ni lam la 'jug pa'i sgrub par gsungs so// de nas tshad med pa bzhi (170ba)dang*/ nang stong pa nyid sogs mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ dngos po thams cad la 'khor gsum gyi rtog pa dag pa dang*/ ched du bya ba chen po gsum dang*/ mngon par shes pa drug dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dag la yang dag par gnas pa'i thabs kyi mtshan nyid kyi sgrub pa ni theg pa chen po'i sgrub pa yin pas sgrub pa'i gnas skabs rnams su ni/ theg pa gsum gyi chos tshul mtha' dag goms pas gnon pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni rnam pa dgu'o// 'grel pa 'dir gnon zhes pa dang*/

gzhung rtsa bar 'dzeg ces pa dang*/ khri brgyad stong par/ de theg chen la zhon te zhes gsungs pa rnams don gcig pas/ gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam de la theg pa'i ming dang*/ de dag la 'jug ste 'gro ba ni zhon pa dang 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya'o// gsum pa tshogs bcu bdun gyi sgrub pa la/ snga ma'i 'brel dang*/ bshad bya'i mdo dgod pa/ gzhung don no// dang po ni/ go sgrub kyi skabs su gang po dang*/ shā ri'i bu'i dris lan las 'phros pa dang*/ 'jug sgrub tu theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa zhes sogs las 'phros pa'o// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ lam la zhugs ma thag pa nas 'jug pa'i stobs gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur bas tshogs gnyis kyi sgrub pa gong nas gong du 'gro bar dgongs te de ma thag tu tshogs sgrub gsung bar mdzad do// gnyis pa 'dir tshogs bcu bdun so so'i mdo ni/ rim pa bzhin du mdo las 'di lta ste/ dang po ni/ rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das go cha chen po bgos pa go cha chen po (171na)bgos/ zhes brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa/ zhes bgyi ba lags/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i go cha ni 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha dang*/ zhes bya ba nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i go cha bgos/ der stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas rgyas par bkang ste/ zhes sogs kun la sbyar te gsungs so// gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing stong gsum gyi/

zhes sogs lhag ma lnga pa'i la'ang*/ rgyas par gsungs so// brgyad pa ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos shing*/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du song zhing ji ltar bdag sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams dag na sems can ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par sbyor zhing 'jog go /'god do// dgu pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi slad du go cha ma mchis pa'i go cha bgo bar rig par bya'o// zhes so// bcu pa ni/ gzugs ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o// tshor ba dang*/ zhes pa rnams so// bcu gcig pa ni/ rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das byang (171ba)chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs par rig par bgyi ba lags/ theg pa des gang nas nges par 'byung ba lags/ theg pa des gang du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba lags/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ste/ zhes so// bcu gnyis pa ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid dang*/ zhes bya ba nas/ gzhan gyi ngo bos stong pa nyid do// zhes so// bcu gsum pa ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ zhes pa rnams so// bcu bzhi pa ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/

dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ zhes sogs so// bco lnga pa ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams te/ zhes gsungs so// bcu drug pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing sa nas sa 'phar te/ zhes so// bcu bdun pa'i mdo ni/ 'og tu gnyen po tshogs sgrub kyi skabs su bshad do// gsum pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun spyir bstan la/ rtogs dka' ba khyad par du bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bshad pa de ltar theg chen la 'jug par byas pa las tshogs skye bas gsum pa (172na)tshogs kyi sgrub pa gsung bar mdzad do// gnyis pa la/ rtsa/ 'grel gnyis las/ dang po ni/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas pa dang*// zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang dang*// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin dang*// ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang*// lam dang gzungs dang sa bcu dang*// gnyen po tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi// rim pa yin par shes par bya// sems can gyi don du go bgos pa rnams kyi nang nas rnam smin las byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis phyogs bcu'i ngan 'gro zhi ba'i phyir 'brel ba med kyang brtse ba chen po dang*/ chos thams cad snang ba tsam las yod pa min pa sgyu ma lta bur dngos stobs kyis 'ong ba la bdag nyid gnas te/ de bzhin gyi sgo nas gzhan dag la'ang sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyin pa la sogs pa drug la 'god par byed pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang ldan pa'i sems rtse gcig pa la gnas nas sems can thams cad la sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyin sogs drug la 'god pa'i zhi gnas te/ de'i ngo bo ni dmigs pa la sems rgyun du 'jog par byed pa de'o// der 'jog byed kyi thabs ni dgu ste/ dmigs pa la sems dang por 'jog pa dang*/ yun bsrings te rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/

'phro na blan te 'jog pa dang*/ mi 'phro ba'i phyir dran pa dang bcas te nye bar 'jog pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la yon tan du mi lta ba'i sgo nas sems 'dul bar byed pa dang*/ rnam par g.yeng ba la nyes dmigs su lta bas sems zhi bar byed pa dang*/ rnam rtog mngon gyur 'byung yang dang du mi len pa dang*/ bying rgod kyi sgo bkag pas sems rtse gcig tu byed pa dang*/ goms pa na 'bad med du sems mnyam par 'jog pa'o// de'i sgra don ni/ rnam g.yeng zhi nas dmigs pa gang yin pa la sems 'jog te gnas pa'o// dmigs pa la yang mtshan ma la dmigs pa dang*/ mtshan med la dmigs pa gnyis so// zhi gnas rang gi ngo bo la yang 'jig rten pas bsdus pa dang*/ 'das lam gyis (172ba)bsdus pa gnyis so// des las su bya ba ci rtsom pa'i rten byed ce na/ yang dag pa'i shes rab skye ba'i rten byed do// ye shes yongs grub kyi gzugs sogs rnam dag gi dmigs pa gang yin pa la kun btags pa'i ngo bo dngos po'i gzugs sogs kyis stong pa'i ye shes ni skyon med pa'i sar zhugs pa rnams kyi lhag mthong yin la/ gzhan du na lhag mthong gi spyi tsam nas ngos 'dzin na/ rig pa dri ma med pa'i stobs kyis drangs pa'i gnas tshul ji lta ba la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i shes rab bo//

de la'ang dbye na/ yul dang yul can gyi cha gnyis kar dmigs pa'i gang zag dang*/ chos kyi bdag la lta ba spangs pa'i bdag med rnam pa gnyis kyis khyad par du byas pa'i shes rab bam/ lhag mthong yang gnyis su yod do// de'i sgra don ni/ ji ltar don la gnas pa de la dpyad nas zhugs pas de mi bslu bar lhag gis mthong ba'am thob pa'o// dpyad pa dang zhugs pa'i lhag mthong ni mos pas spyod pa na yang yod cing*/ thob pa'i lhag mthong ni 'das lam kho na la'o// de lta bu'i lhag mthong gis ni ma rtogs pa'i blo ste log rtog dang the tshom gsum ga drungs 'byin par byed pa yin no// de ltar go bgos pa'i sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen de'i yongs grub kyi chos nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs sogs gzhom du med pa gang yin pa ni ma bcings pa dang ma grol ba'i ye shes yin pas/ de nyid la thabs rgya che ba dang shes rab zab pa gnyis ka tshang bas de tshang ba ltar zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang yin pa de'o// de lta bu'i bcu po de ni theg pa la gnas nas go cha chen po sgom par 'jog byed yin la/ brtse ba ni bsam pa rnam dag gi (173na)chos dang*/ sbyin sogs ni sbyor ba khyad par can gyi chos dang*/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong thabs shes zung 'brel gyi lam gsum ni srid zhi gnyis su mi ltung bar 'dzin pa'i chos so// de'i lhag ma bdun gyis ni theg pa rang gi ngo bo bstan la de'ang bgrod byed lam gyi ngo bo dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i rgyu gnyis las/ dang pos ni thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang*/ ye shes kyi rgyu dang*/ bsod nams kyi ngo bo dang*/ gzungs kyi byed las te bzhi bstan to// gnyis pa ni sa dang gnyen po'o// de dag gis ni lam gyi 'gros bshad nas/ 'phros kyi 'bru mu nas gnyer ba ni/ chos thams cad la dmigs pa med par phyin drug gi thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa des sems can thams cad sgrol bar byed pa dang*/

ye shes dang ni zhes pa'i ye shes de glo bur ba'i chos thams cad kyis stong pa'i chos nyid de chos kyi dbyings yin pa dang*/ de rang nyid la rang rig pa yang yin pas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes zhes pa'i yul can rnam dag de nyid yin no// de lta bu'i stong nyid dang ye shes de la ni ma skyes pa'i stong nyid dang ye shes su brjod de/ ji skad du/ ma skyes pa yi stong nyid mchog /skyes pa'i stong pa 'jig pa yin// ces gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal ba byams pas/ med pa dang*/ yod pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi stong nyid gsum yod pa las/ yongs grub rang bzhin gyi stong nyid dang*/ ye shes ma shes par de'i stong nyid dang*/ ye shes mi shes pa kho nar gsungs la/ yang gal te 'ga' zhig rje btsun gyis de ltar gsungs pa dang*/ yum gyi mdor yang yongs grub kyi chos nyid stong nyid du gsungs pa shin tu yang bden pa 'thad de/ de ltar gyi tshe de rang stong du gsungs (173ba)kyi/ gzhan stong du ma gsungs so zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/ mdor/ sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes bstan pas/ glo bur ba'i sems rang stong yin pas ma mchis pa dang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gzhan stong yin pas 'od gsal ba'o zhes mi stong par bstan pa dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// ces chos nyid bla na med pa gang yin pa'i chos de rang gi ngo bo mi stong par gsungs la/ don de gsal bar/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dpal gyis/ phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid// chu shing bzhin du snying po med// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin// ces phung po sogs kun btags pa dang*/ gzhan dbang gi chos thams cad rang gi ngo bo la rnam par dpyad pa na/ rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid de/ dper na chu shing snying po med pa bzhin yin la/ yongs grub rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid de ni spyir dpyad mi nus pa dang*/

ji ltar dpyad kyang rang gi ngo bos stong pa de ltar 'gyur ba ma yin te/ de lta bu'i ye shes mchog de nyid las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes gsung ngo*// 'ga' zhig gis gzhan stong gi stong pa nyid kyis stong nyid kyi go mi chod de/ de'i rang ngo stong nyid ma yin pas so zhes zer ro// de ni 'thad pa ma yin te/ stong nyid yin pa la stong gzhi dang stong bya dang gang gis gang stong pa'i rnam gzhag med pa'i stong nyid de stong nyid go chod po ma yin par theg chen gyi chos mngon pa las bshad pa dang*/ stong nyid go chod po de stong bya gang gis stong gzhi gang yin pa stong pa'i stong nyid de stong pa go chod du gsungs kyi/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i stong pas stong nyid (174na)go chod por brtsi na/ rang gi ngo bo rang la mi gnas pa zhig la rang stong du bshad pas/ de ltar na mo gsham gyi bu sogs chad stong thams cad kyang stong nyid go chod por thal bas mi rung ngo*// gzhan yang gzhan stong gi rang ngo mi stong pa'i nyes pa yang yod pa ma yin te/ gzhi de la khyad par gzhan rnams rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i stong pa nyid la gzhan stong gi ming sbyar ba yin pas/ gzhan stong gi rang ngo mi stong par mi 'gyur ro// de'i rgyu mtshan gzhi de dang des stong pa'i tshogs don de la gzhan stong gi ming sbyar ba yin gyi/ chos nyid kyi gzhi de ni rang gi ngo bos stong par ni mi 'dod de/ de gzhan stong yang ma yin pas gzhan stong ma yin na rang stong yin pa ni lta yang smos pa ma yin no// 'on te 'dis gzhan stong gi stong gzhi byed kyi/ rang stong gi stong gzhir ni mi rung ngo*// de'i rgyu mtshan chos can gzhan gyi stong bya zin pa'i stong nyid dang ris mthun de de'i stong gzhir rung la/ cig shos la der mi rung bas so// ris mthun pa'i don ni/ gzhan dri ma glo bur ba rnams zad pa dang*/

mi skye bar shes pa'i shes rab stong nyid de dang*/ snying po'i chos nyid kyi gzhi de dmigs rnam mthun pa yin no// cig shos ni de dang dmigs rnam mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan glo bur ba'i chos thams cad rang grub tsam nas mi rtag par rang gi ngo bo 'gag pa'i tshul gyis stong pa yin pas/ de dang ni dam pa'i chos nyid kyi gzhi dmigs rnam mthun pa ma yin te/ chos nyid kyi gzhi de ni mi rtag pa dang rang gi ngo bo grub tsam nas 'jig pa dang*/ 'gag pa dang skye ba gang yang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir na de dang dmigs rnam mthun pa min no// gzhan dri (174ba)ma zad mi skye shes pa'i shes rab ni/ rtag pa mi 'gyur ba'i chos nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i chos nyid la dmigs pa'i tshe na dmigs rnam mthun pas so// gzhan stong gi rang ngo rang stong yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang yod de/ chos can glo bur ba gzhan gyis stong bzhin pa'i gzhan stong de chos can/ gzhi las gzhan pa glo bur dri ma de rang gi ngo bo skad cig tu mi sdod par stong bzhin pa can yin te/ chos can kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan des na gzhan stong yin pa la rang stong yin pas khyab pa zhig nges par khas len dgos la/ rang stong du khas len pa'i stong nyid de stong nyid go chod du khas len na ni rang stong las gzhan pa'i gzhan stong khas len par mi rung ngo*// 'o na chos nyid kyi gzhi de gzhan stong dang rang stong gnyis ka ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de rang dang gzhan gyis stong mi stong gi khyad par du ma byas pa'i stong nyid tsam du yang mi rung ste/ stong pa dang mi stong pa'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ des na spros pa dang bral ba'i ngor chos nyid kyi gzhi de la rang gzhan gyis stong pa'i mtshan ma gang yang mi 'byung ba yin no// spros pa dang bcas pa'i ngor ni rang dang gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid gnyis po la gzhan stong mchog yin cing rang stong dman pa yin la/

de'i rgyu mtshan rang stong gi gnas tshul ji lta bar ma rtogs na/ gzhan stong gi gnas tshul mi rtogs pa'am mi dpogs pa yin no// rang stong go zhing dpogs pa la ni gzhan stong gi gnas tshul ma go yang rang stong gi go ba dpogs pa ni bde blag tu 'grub bo// de ni myong bas nges pa'i tshad ma yin pas skal ba (175na)dang ldan pa dag 'di la yid rton cig / 'dir smras pa/ gzhan mchog stong nyid seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa// gang des rang stong wa skad sgrog shes kyang*// rang stong ngan pa'i wa skad 'byin pa des// gzhan stong zab mo'i seng skad ci ste thos// dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par bzhag nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par byed pa dang zhes gsungs pas/ skabs 'dir yang ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa dang*/ gong du chos mchog skabs su ting nge 'dzin rnams bstan pa'i khyad par ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mthar thug gi byed pas myur du 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa las/ 'dir zur du bkol nas gnas skabs ting nge 'dzin gyi byed pa bye brag tu bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi zag med 'das lam gyis sems rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa'i bya ba mi byed pa gtsor byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'dir bstan pa yin no// des na 'dir bstan gyi ting nge 'dzin de khams gsum pa'i bsam gtan dang ma 'dres pa yin no// lam dang zhes pa la mdo dang sbyor na/ 'dir lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa rgyas par bshad la/ 'dir grangs rags rim tsam 'dren na 'di lta ste/ byang phyogs so bdun las rim bzhin dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do// mtshan nyid gsum gyi chos la rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan med smon gsum ste rnam thar sgo gsum mo//

shes pa bcu gcig ni/ sdug bsngal shes pa dang*/ kun 'byung shes pa dang*/ 'gog pa shes pa dang*/ (175ba)lam shes pa dang*/ zad pa shes pa dang*/ mi skye ba shes pa dang*/ chos shes pa dang*/ rjes su rtogs pa shes pa dang*/ kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ yongs su 'dris pa shes pa dang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa shes pa'o// dbang po gsum ni/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po dang*/ kun shes pa'i dbang po dang*/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po ste gsum mo// ting nge 'dzin gsum ni/ rtog dpyod dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rtog pa med la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ mi dpyod mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin te gsum mo// rjes dran bcu ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ gtong ba dang*/ lha dang*/ skye ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ lus su rtog pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung rngub dran pa ste bcu'o// tshad med bzhi ni/ byams snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi'o// de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i byang sems la yon tan gsum gsum dang ldan pa yin te/ bsam pa'i dang*/ 'phel ba'i dang*/ dmigs pa'i ste che ba'i yon tan gsum dang*/ gcig pa nyid kyi yon tan dang*/ gnod pa med pa'i yon tan la yang phyi rol dang*/ nang gi dang*/ phyi rol sems can gyis byas pa'i dang*/ phyi rol gyi 'du byed las gyur pa'i gnod pa med pa gsum mo// gzhan yang bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang*/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi skye mched dang*/ rnam shes dang*/ ci yang med dang*/ 'du shes med/ 'du shes med min gyi skye mched do// rnam thar brgyad la/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi dang*/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba dang*/ gzugs can ma yin pa gzugs la lta ba dang*/ khyad par sdug pa dang mi sdug pa ste (176na)brgyad do// mthar gyis snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni/ bsam gzugs brgyad/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang dgu'o//

gzhan yang stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad de dran nye nas ma 'dres pa'i bar gyi chos tshan nyer gcig bstan pa ni 'dir bstan gyi lam mo// gzungs dang zhes pa ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud la legs pa'i lam gzung ba ste/ de'i skad dod du dhā ra zhes 'byung la/ de yang 'dzin par byed pa la 'jug pas 'dzin pa de gzung bar byed pas na gzungs so// de yang mdor/ yi ge'i tshul mnyam pa nyid dang*/ brjod pa mnyam pa nyid dang*/ yi ge'i sgo dang*/ yi ges rab tu 'jug pa'o// zhes bstan pa'i don a zhes pa nas/ ha zhes bya ba'i bar gyis yi ge'i ngo bo dang*/ rnam pa thams cad skye med du mnyam pa nyid dang*/ de rjod byed kyi sgra thams cad kyang ma skyes par mnyam pa dang*/ yi ge lta bu'i sgo nas 'jug pa la brten nas tshig dang don gyi gzungs rnams bde blag tu rtogs nus pa dang*/ yi ge dang de la brten nas chos nyid rtogs pa la rab tu 'jug pas yi ge rab 'jug ces bya'o// des na yi ge a lta bu zhig gi sgra don la brtags nas skye ba med par rtogs pa na/ chos thams cad la tshul des rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas rmongs pa sel thub pa'i gzungs kyi sgo rnams mngon du byed nus pas/ de bzhin du ra pa tsa na sogs yi ge 'bru zhe gnyis tsam 'byung ba thams cad kyi sgra don rdul dang bral ba sogs la 'jug par mthong nas gzungs thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro// de nyid grub pa 'ga' zhig gi gsung gis/ gzungs kyi (176ba)yi ge gzhom med yin pa'i phyir// de la dmigs nas mnyam par bzhag pa na// dmigs po'i rig rgyun 'gags nas chos kyi dbyings// a ra pa sogs rdo rje'i dbyangs gsal rnams// mkha' la 'char tshe 'phags pas gzungs thob 'gyur// zhes kyang gsung ngo*// des na a lta bu'i gzungs kyi sgo gcig gis chos thams cad la rgyas gdab ste sgom pa'i rgyas 'debs kyi tshul 'di la mdor/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya'i rgyas 'debs dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rgyas 'debs su gsungs la/ sngags kyi theg par ni/ las/ chos/ dam tshig /chen po ste bzhis rgyas 'debs par gsungs pas/ zab mo'i don mthar thug pa bsgom pa'i thabs ni 'di nyid yin pa la/ deng sang la la zhig stong nyid rgyas 'debs su bsgoms pa'i sgom pas stong nyid bsgoms pa'i go mi chod par smra mkhan shin tu mang yang*/ de ltar na mdo rgyud thams cad du phyag rgya'i rgyas 'debs kyi sgom rim rnams la skur ba btab par 'gyur bas de ltar mi smra bar byos shig/ des na rgyas 'debs kyi don ni 'di yin te/ dbu ma lta bu'i sgom rim 'ga' zhig la ni chos can gcig rig pas dpyad nas ma rnyed pa'i rig pa des chos can gzhan thams cad la de ltar rgyas btab nas bsgom par gsungs pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg par mtshon na/ tha mal gyi chos can cig mi snang bar bde ba chen po'i stong nyid du bcug pa'i rim pa des tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad la de ltar rgyas btab nas bsgom pa yin la/ de ni zhar la 'ongs pa'o// gzungs kyi skabs 'dir/ nyi snang las/ yi ge'i mtshan mar byed pa de dang des bskal pa mang por chos ston pa'i rgyu'i dran pa gtugs pa med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ (177na)dran pa'ang yi ge dang don 'dzin pa nyid kyis gzungs yin pas so// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i gzungs la dbye na bzhi yod pa las/ dang po tshig gi gzungs ni/ sar zhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams la chos nyan pa na/ sngar mi shes shing ma thos pa'i ming tshig yi ger gtogs pa'i chos rgya chen po rnams thos pa'i rim pa de nyid kyis mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'o//

gnyis pa don gyi gzungs ni/ chos de rnams kyi don tshad med pa de dus dpag pa med cing tshad med par 'dzin pa'i dran shes so// de la don tshad med pa ni/ de yul can du byed pa'i blos ji srid bar gzhal yang mtha' mi mngon pa la bya'o// dus tshad med pa ni tshe rabs tshad med pa la bya'o// 'di lta bu'i gzungs la/ sa dang po nas gzungs dang sar gzungs tshad med pa dang grangs med pa du ma thob par gsungs so// gsum pa 'phags pa 'thob byed kyi gzungs ni/ a sogs kyi yi ge la brten nas bzod pa chen po thob cing*/ bzod pa de la brten nas 'das lam gyi bzod pa thob par byed pa'i gzungs te/ byang sa las/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa bzod pa chen po la gnas par 'gyur te/ 'dis ni byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa thob par byed pa'i gzungs yin par rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa gsang sngags kyi gzungs ni/ sar zhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings kyi mthus sngags 'bras byin gyis brlabs nas sngags des 'go ba'i rims nad sogs zhi bar byed pa'o// de ltar gyi tshe gsang sngags dngos ni chos nyid dang de'i mthu yin la/ sngags tshig ni des khyad par du byas pa'i ngag go /'di bzhi ka la gzungs zhes sbyar ba'i don ni/ snga ma gnyis gzungs (177ba)dngos yin pas gzungs zhes sbyar la/ phyi ma gnyis la'ang zad mi skye shes pa'i bzod pa rgyud la 'dzin pas na gzungs dang sngags rten gyi tshig 'bru rnams kyis sngags 'bras byin rlabs 'dzin par byed pas na gzungs zhes sbyar la/ de ltar de dang des 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsam las gzhan kho bo la rgyu mtshan bsnyad rgyu ci yang med do// de ltar bzhir dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ dang po la gnyis su 'byed pa ni yul tshig don gnyis yod pa las/ de yul can du byed pa'i gzungs gnyis su 'byed do// tha ma la gnyis su 'byed pa ni/

rang don gyi byed pa dang gzhan don gyi byed pa gnyis su yod pas gnyis su 'byed do// gzungs de'i rgyu ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ thos pa dang goms pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i gzungs dang gsum mo// dang po ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang*/ phyi ma gnyis ni mthong chos kyi 'bras bu'o// ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i gzungs la che 'bring chung gsum yod de/ che ba ni dag sa dang*/ 'bring ni ma dag sa dang*/ chung ngu ni sar ma zhugs pa'i rgyud la yod pa'o// tshig dang don 'phags pa 'thob byed kyi gzungs gsum po ni sbyor lam bzod pa yan nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du yod do// gsang sngags kyi gzungs ni/ sa dang po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar ro// de lta'i gzungs la tshogs sbyor ba'i gzungs ni brtan cing rgya che ba ma yin la/ sa thob nas brtan cing rgya che ba'i gzungs su byang sa las gsungs so// de ltar gzungs kyi rjes thog tu sa bcu'i tshogs sgrub dang*/ gnyen po'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa'i rim pa yin par mkhas pas shes par bya'o zhes bya ba gsungs te zhes (178na)bkod do// gnyis pa 'grel pa ni/ brtse ba snying rje chen po'i tshogs sgrub dang*/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong dang*/ zung du 'brel ba'i lam dang*/ thabs mkhas pa dang*/ ye shes dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ mthong ba dang la sogs pas lam lhag ma gzhan dang*/ tshig dang la sogs pas gzungs lhag ma rnams dang*/ sa dang gnyen po'i tshogs te bcu bdun po 'di rnams rang gi ngo bos grub pa'i rang bzhin du mi dmigs pas lta ba las ma g.yos bzhin du/ kun rdzob tu sa dang lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsam gyi dbang du byas nas de nyid kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bar theg pa chen po'i don mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa yin la/

de'i phyir snying rje la sogs pa'i sgrub pa bcu bdun po 'di dag gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i ngo bo'i thabs yin pas/ thabs de la ni lam gyi yan lag ma tshang ba med par tshang ba'i tshogs dgos shing*/ rgyu'i tshogs pa des ni 'bras bu byang chub chen po 'byin par byed pa'i phyir na/ snying rje chen po la sogs pa'i sgrub pa bcu bdun po 'di ni tshogs yin pas/ rgyu mtshan des na tshogs kyi sgrub pa nyid la'ang rnam pa bcu bdun du grangs nges pa yin no// smras pa/ theg chen lam la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang*// zhugs nas gzhan gyi don la go bgos te// rang gzhan don sgrub tshogs pa bsags pa la// mi ngal bya ba brtsam tshul bshad zin to// gsum pa rtogs dka' ba khyad par du bshad pa la gsum/ ye shes kyi tshogs khyad par du bshad (178ba)pa/ sa'i tshogs khyad par du bshad pa/ gnyen po'i tshogs khyad par du bshad pa'i dang po la/ spyi don dang*/ tshig don gnyis las/ dang po la yang*/ yul stong pa nyid dang yul can ye shes kyis ji ltar dmigs pa'i tshul bshad pa dang*/ stong nyid kyi rnam grangs de la 'dod tshul mi gcig pa brjod pa dang gnyis las/ dang po la'ang*/ thog mar yul stong pa nyid gang la ngos 'dzin pa'i 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las/ gzhan stong smra ba'i sems tsam pa dang thun mong ba'i lugs la ni/ stong gzhi gzhan dbang gi stobs kyis gnyis su snang ba'i shes pa dang*/ shes pa des bzhag pa'i bag chags so// de'i steng gi dgag bya ni kun tu btags pa ste/ de la'ang gnyis snang gi cha dang*/ cha re re la'ang gang zag dang chos kyis sgro btags pa'i cha gnyis gnyis so// des de stong pa'i stong nyid ni gnyis stong gi dngos po'o// de la'ang gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa lta bu nyi tshe ba dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa lta bu khyab pa'i stong nyid do// de ltar gyi tshe nyi tshe ba'i stong nyid dang chos nyid dang de bzhin nyid rnams la ni nyan rang 'phags pas kyang dmigs pa yin te/

ṭīka chung du/ ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rim gyis dmigs pa de bzhin du zhes gsungs so// 'on te nyan rang 'phags pas nyi tshe ba'i stong nyid sogs bshad ma thag pa de la dmigs shing*/ rang gi ngo skal gyis rnyed pa'i 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu zhig rtogs kyang*/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa ni lugs 'dir mi 'dod do// lugs 'dir rgyu mtshan des 'phags pa 'og ma'i dbang du byas na/ mig sogs nang gi ngo bor nang gi (179na)byed pos stong pa la nang stong pa nyid kyi don du 'chad pa ni gang zag gi gdags gzhi phung khams skye mched rnams yin pa la/ de dang de rang gi ngo bos stong par bshad na chos kyi bdag med kyi don du thal bas/ chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong par mthong ba'i mig ni 'phags pa 'og ma la med do// rang stong smra ba'i dbu ma pa dang thun mong ba'i lugs la ni/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad stong gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i steng gi dgag bya ni chos rnams la rang rang gi ngo bos grub par yod pa'i zhen blo de'o// de la'ang chos rnams kyi rang gi ngo bo zhes pa'i ngo bo 'di la bden pa gnyis su 'byed dgos kyi/ de ltar gyi don dam pa'i dbang du byas na/ chos thams cad la ngo bo med pas ngo bos stong pa de de'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo yin ces tha snyad zor yang ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ de tsam la yang brgal zhing brtag pa'i gnas ni du ma zhig yod do// kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas na ni/ ka ba lta bu zhig la dper mtshon na/ ka ba'i rnam pa de nyid kyis gdung 'degs pa sogs byed las dang ldan pa de de'i ngo bor 'jog la/ deng sang mi shes pa mang pos ni kun rdzob pa'i ka ba'i rnam pa dang ngo bo dang rang bzhin gsum rdzas tha dad du khas blangs nas/ rigs pa des chos thams cad la sbyar te bsam gtan pa'i khrid yig mang por zab don du bris gda' ba la ni snying po cung zad kyang med de/

ka bum sogs kyi ngo bo don byed nus sogs mngon sum gyis dmigs pa las/ dbang po'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'am ma dmigs pa ka bum sogs kyi ngo bo rdzas su yod pa ni snang du mi rung ba'i phyir yod med 'dre sha za'i bum pa dang 'dra'o// 'o na yang gong du bshad pa'i bum sogs kun rdzob pa'i ngo bo med (179ba)pa'am stong pa de don dam bden pa'i rang bzhin du 'dod pa ni don dam bden pa'i rnam gzhag khas len pa de'i tshe yin gyi/ rnam gzhag de yang khas mi len pa'i tshe ni kun rdzob kyi ngo bos stong pa'i don dam pa'i rang bzhin de nyid rang bzhin de nyid kyis stong ngo zhes brjod dgos la/ de ltar ma brjod na ni stong pa nyid la der lta ba'i lta ba ni ches cher phung bar byed pa'i lta ba yin ces bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub kyis yang nas yang du gsungs la/ des na de dang de'i stong pa nyid gang yin pa de de'i rang bzhin du med de/ dngos po rnams bden pa gnyis char gyi ngo bos stong par 'dod pa'i phyir dang*/ ka bum sogs rang bzhin gyis med par 'dod pa de'i tshe na ni/ de'i rang bzhin dang snying por gyur pa'i don dam bden pa dang gnas lugs kyang mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro// des de stong pa'i stong nyid la ni rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang*/ grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa gnyis la 'dod tshul so sor yod pas/ dang po ni/ ji srid stong pa nyid kyi rnam gzhag ma bklags pa de'i tshe ni de'i ngo bo shes par 'dod de/ stong nyid bzhi pa'i stong gzhi de shes par 'dod pa de'i phyir ro// der 'dod pa yang*/ ji skad du/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong pa nyid yin pas stong pa nyid stong pa nyid des chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa ni 'dir chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin la/ des kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid de der 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa spangs pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so//

gnyis pa ni/ de dang des stong pa'i ngo bo med dgag nam mkha' ltar 'dod do// yul can ye shes kyi dmigs pa ni stong pa nyid yin par/ nyi snang las/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dmigs pa de ci (180na)zhig yin ce na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do zhes brjod do// zhes gsungs la/ de la theg pa 'og ma pa dag na re/ dmigs bya stong nyid chos can/ yod pa ma yin par thal/ rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs nas med pa'i phyir/ dper na mo gsham gyi bu bzhin no// des na rang bzhin ma dmigs na yod pa ma yin pas khyab/ dper na bum dag gi phyogs la bum pa mi dmigs pa bzhin dmigs bya stong nyid kyang stong nyid du yod pa ma yin no// des na dgag pa gnyis rnal mar go ba'i phyir/ chos thams cad yod par thal ces dang*/ yang stong nyid de chos can/ stong nyid du yod pa ma yin par thal/ ye shes kyi dmigs bya yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs bya yin na stong nyid du 'gal la/ ci ste stong pa sogs med pa'i dngos po dmigs rung na/ yod pa'i dngos po phung sogs dmigs byar cis mi rung bas chos thams cad mi stong par yod par thal/ ces zer ro// de la lan 'debs par 'dod nas rnam brdzun smra ba'i sems tsam pa na re/ gnyis med kyi ye shes la ni/ de'i ngor dmigs bya stong nyid dang*/ dmigs byed ye shes gnyis tha dad pa gnyis med kyi/ ye shes de nyid kyang stong nyid yin pas/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de nyid kyis de nyid dmigs pa la stong nyid dmigs zhes pa'i tha snyad byas pa yin gyi/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes las gzhan pa'i stong pa nyid ni mi 'dod pas nyes pa des mi gnod do zhes zer te/ ji skad du/ dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir/ 'di ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes tsam yin te/ stong pa nyid ces bya ba ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no zhes kha cig zer ro// zhes gsungs so//

rnam (180ba)bden pas ni lan 'di skad du 'debs te/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid med dgag de med dgag nyid du dmigs pa dang*/ de 'jal byed kyi 'dzin rnam la ni mi rtog ye shes su 'jog la/ de ltar bzhag pas mngon sum yul med du mi 'gyur ro zhes/ ji skad du/ kha cig tu ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i cha gnyis la gnas pa gnyis kyis na/ cha gcig la dmigs pa ni ma yin no zhes 'dod do// zhes gsungs so// lan de gnyis kyang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dag gis mi 'thad par bstan pas/ de yang lan dang po mi 'thad pa la/ dag pa gong nas gong du 'gro ba med par thal ba dang*/ ye shes yul med du thal ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mi rtog ye shes chos can/ khyod kyis sngar glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid la dmigs nas/ phyis dri ma rim gyis dag pa'i de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i sgo nas dag pa gong 'phel du 'gro rgyu med par thal/ dang po nyid nas gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma mtha' dag gis dag pa'i de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i phyir/ de la nyes pa spong bar 'dod nas/ gal te dang po nyid nas rang bzhin gyis dag kyang glo bur gyi dri ma rim gyis spong ba yin no zhe na/ rnam brdzun pa chos can/ khyod kyi lugs la gnyis med kyi ye shes la bden 'dzin spong du mi rung bar thal/ khyod kyi lugs la de rang bzhin gyis ma grub par 'jal ba'i mngon sum dang rigs pa gnyis ka med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na dag pa phyogs gcig pa nyid du 'gyur te/ de la gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma dag tu rung yang*/ rang la bden 'dzin gyi dri ma mi spong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ye shes yul med du thal ba ni/ ji (181na)skad du/ snga ma'i phyogs dag la ni/ ye shes dngos po med pa'i spyod yul du 'gyur zhing*/ zhes 'byung bas/ de'i don ni/ gnyis med kyi ye shes chos can/
